name: brand-mark-source
body:
Source of the kalide mark [with user — revised source]. The user supplied the logo SVG below; nothing is recreated. It is split into `brand/logo_light.svg` (the light-filled hexagon tile, for light backgrounds) and `brand/logo_dark.svg` (the dark-filled hexagon tile, for dark backgrounds / dark mode).

(a) SUPPLIED SVG (verbatim):
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 512 512">
  <path d="m317.49 380.58-41.57 24.1-.02 47.62 41.23 23.77 41.63-23.85-.18-47.79z" style="stroke-width:6;stroke-linejoin:round;fill:#e6e7e6" transform="translate(-182.29 -300.11)"/>
  <path d="M348.7 398.02 316.69 432l22.67 32.45 20.23-10.2-1.07-49.4z" style="fill:#ff5a25;stroke-width:1;transform-origin:594.616px 588.65px" transform="translate(-182.29 -300.11)"/>
  <path d="m229.8 200.24 1.12-35.58.15-45.11" style="fill:none;stroke-width:4px;stroke:#121419;transform-origin:230.439px 159.894px" transform="translate(-109.59 -30.04)"/>
  <path d="m265.83 197.28-46.75-69.87" style="fill:none;stroke-width:4px;stroke:#121419" transform="translate(-109.59 -30.04)"/>
  <path d="m214.87 190.17 27.2-26.47 32.85-34.1" style="fill:none;stroke-width:4;stroke:#121419;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 50%" transform="translate(-109.59 -30.04)"/>
  <path d="m245.18 112.16-41.57 23.91-.03 47.62 41.23 23.95 41.63-23.65-.17-47.8z" style="stroke-width:6;stroke-linejoin:round;fill:none;transform-origin:576.872px 588.518px;stroke:#121419" transform="translate(-109.59 -30.04)"/>
  <path d="m317.49 380.58-41.57 24.1-.02 47.62 41.23 23.77 41.63-23.85-.18-47.79z" style="stroke-width:6;stroke-linejoin:round;fill:#121419" transform="translate(-78.44 -301.66)"/>
  <path d="M348.7 398.02 316.69 432l22.67 32.45 20.23-10.2-1.07-49.4z" style="fill:#ff5a25;stroke-width:1;transform-origin:594.616px 588.65px" transform="translate(-78.44 -301.66)"/>
  <path d="m229.8 200.24 1.12-35.58.15-45.11" style="fill:none;stroke-width:4px;transform-origin:230.439px 159.894px;stroke:#e6e7e6" transform="translate(-5.74 -31.59)"/>
  <path d="m265.83 197.28-46.75-69.87" style="fill:none;stroke-width:4px;stroke:#e6e7e6" transform="translate(-5.74 -31.59)"/>
  <path d="m214.87 190.17 27.2-26.47 32.85-34.1" style="fill:none;stroke-width:4;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 50%;stroke:#e6e7e6" transform="translate(-5.74 -31.59)"/>
  <path d="m245.18 112.16-41.57 23.9-.03 47.63 41.23 23.95L286.44 184l-.17-47.8Z" style="stroke-width:6;stroke-linejoin:round;fill:none;transform-origin:576.872px 588.518px;stroke:#e6e7e6" transform="translate(-5.74 -31.59)"/>
</svg>

(b) Split/crop recipe:
- LIGHT tile → `brand/logo_light.svg`: the FIRST 6 `<path>` elements. The hexagon and orange facet use `translate(-182.29 -300.11)`; the facet lines and outline use `translate(-109.59 -30.04)`. Extents including stroke are about x 90.6–179.9, y 77.5–180.6. Suggested square crop `viewBox="79.2 73 112 112"`.
- DARK tile → `brand/logo_dark.svg`: the LAST 6 `<path>` elements, using `translate(-78.44 -301.66)` and `translate(-5.74 -31.59)`. Extents are about x 194.5–283.7, y 75.9–179.1. Suggested square crop `viewBox="183.1 71.5 112 112"`.
- Keep the path data and transforms unchanged, set the cropped square viewBox, and drop the other tile's paths.
- Recolour `#e6e7e6`→`#F8F9FA`, `#121419`→`#0F1115`, `#ff5a25`→`#FF5722`; after recolouring, each file uses only those three colours.
- Verify the hexagon is visually centred. The crops are guidance derived from the path data.
- The dark tile's last outline path is written with slightly different commands (`L`/`Z`, `23.9`) than the light tile's. It is the same shape; keep it as supplied.

(c) The `transform-origin`/`transform-box` style properties are inert (only translate applies) and may be kept or removed.

The mark was designed to stay legible down to 16px; no PNG exports are required for 0.5.0.
